identity.relationshipToGes: Separate experiment. GES-SEC-US-PILOT@1.0.0 remains unchanged and must not be reinterpreted by this protocol.

researchQuestion: Can a strictly point-in-time early-detection matrix identify durable growth companies at least two published quarters before first GQS qualification and, in a meaningful share of cases, before the primary price breakout?

systemBoundary.gqsRole: current fundamental growth-and-quality confirmation baseline; its historical timing is an open hypothesis
systemBoundary.matrixRole: research prioritisation and handoff candidate generation
systemBoundary.scorePolicy: No composite pseudo-precision score. Preserve dimensions and evidence quality separately.

fiveClocks.theme: first public evidence that the technical, economic or regulatory development is becoming feasible or adopted
fiveClocks.beneficiary: first evidence that the specific company can capture material economic value
fiveClocks.operations: first evidence from orders, capacity, customers, backlog, product launch, investment or comparable operating facts
fiveClocks.market: first relative-strength, volume, industry-momentum or objective breakout event
fiveClocks.fundamental: first published growth/quality evidence and first GQS qualification

primaryGrowthBreakout.requiredQuarterKey: entity_id plus fiscal_year plus fiscal_quarter; array position and compressed available-row order are prohibited
primaryGrowthBreakout.continuityRule: q-4, each of the four prior YoY observations, and q+1 through q+4 must be exact consecutive fiscal quarters; any missing required period makes the event NOT_COMPUTABLE
primaryGrowthBreakout.eventDate: first public availability timestamp of the qualifying quarter
primaryGrowthBreakout.maturityDate: availability timestamp of q+4; q+1 through q+4 are outcome labels only and never signal inputs
primaryGrowthBreakout.denominatorRule: growth_q = revenue_q / revenue_q-4 - 1 only when the as-filed prior-year denominator is positive
primaryGrowthBreakout.eventMultiplicityPrimary: earliest qualifying event per entity only
primaryGrowthBreakout.eventMultiplicitySecondary: all qualifying events separated by at least 12 fiscal quarters; uncertainty remains entity-clustered

durability.economicMeasureRule: one frozen sector-appropriate measure named before outcome access; positive year-over-year growth in at least three of q+1 through q+4
durability.perShareRule: revenue per diluted weighted-average share has positive year-over-year growth in at least three of q+1 through q+4
durability.acquisitionRule: reported or adjudicated acquisition revenue contribution must be at most 50 percent in q through q+4; missing contribution makes the event NOT_COMPUTABLE
durability.valueCaptureRule: a blinded, sourced value-capture mechanism must be accepted at q; missing or rejected evidence makes the event NOT_COMPUTABLE
durability.financingRule: the per-share rule is the primary dilution guard; financing dependence remains a reported secondary flag and cannot rescue a failed event

primaryPriceBreakout.definition: close_t > max(close_t-252 through close_t-1), with no other 252-session breakout in t-63 through t-1
primaryPriceBreakout.firstEligibleZeroBasedIndex: lookback + quietSessions: 315 for the 252-session primary and 189 for the 126-session secondary
primaryPriceBreakout.youngListingPolicy: separately right-censored; never treated as no-breakout
primaryPriceBreakout.signalAvailability: next eligible market open after the qualifying close
primaryPriceBreakout.priceSeries: point-in-time split/dividend-adjusted closing history; later corporate actions must not rewrite historical feature values

technicalFeatures.purpose: information processing and market confirmation, never standalone investability
features: 63-session and 126-session total-return spread versus the historical sector benchmark and broad market
MACD 12/26/9 with exponential moving averages seeded by the first simple average
Wilder RSI 14 with the original 14-change seed and recursive Wilder smoothing
current volume versus the median of the prior 120 completed sessions, excluding the current session
Bollinger 20/2 inside Keltner 20/1.5 using true range, with 20-session linear-regression endpoint of close minus the mean of Donchian midpoint and SMA

candidateStateRules.M1: positive 63-session and 126-session total-return spread versus both the historical sector benchmark and the broad-market benchmark; all four spreads must be positive and known at the close
candidateStateRules.M2: 126-session closing breakout after a 63-session inclusive quiet window; volume and industry movement cannot set M2
candidateStateRules.M3: 252-session closing breakout after a 63-session quiet period and positive 126-session sector-relative return

technicalFeatures.exploratoryFamilyRule: Exploratory indicators cannot set a candidate state. Any later confirmatory use requires a new sealed multiple-testing family.
technicalFeatures.historicalLowProhibition: Historical lows may be described after the fact but never used as contemporaneous input.
technicalFeatures.missingOhlcvRule: Squeeze and volume analyses are NOT_COMPUTABLE, not zero and not inferred from adjusted close.

levels.2: observable investment, orders, regulation or commercial introduction
levels.3: accelerating real adoption with measurable bottlenecks or demand

levels.2: documented product, customer, order or necessary infrastructure
levels.3: material exposure, bottleneck, pricing power or hard-to-replace value capture
repeated filing evidence or filing evidence plus independent external evidence

levels.2: 126-session closing breakout after a 63-session inclusive quiet window; volume and industry movement cannot set M2
top-decile qualification in two consecutive historical monthly vintages

states.PRE_GROWTH_CANDIDATE: T>=2 and E>=2 and L>=2 before outcome visibility
states.GQS_CONFIRMED: G>=1; primary definition is first as-of monthly vintage in the unchanged sector branch's historical top decile of the eligible cohort; board entry and top-200 are secondary variants
states.ELLIOTT_REVIEW: T>=2 and E>=2 and L>=2 with accepted data quality; independent of G and M
states.REJECTED_HOLD: contradicted, narrative only, insufficient value capture or unacceptable data

operationalSignals: backlog, RPO, bookings and order intake
new production lines and commercial product launches
R&D efficiency, patents and scientific activity
government contracts, grants and regulatory clearances
insider and capital-allocation decisions when point-in-time available

studyArms.A_gqs_timing: Growth event, price breakout, first GQS qualification and matrix signal for all reconstructable US entities.
studyArms.B_technical_null: Only price, volume and industry data may predict future growth breakout; no themes or later company data.
D_ai_removal: remove direct and necessary AI infrastructure
remove every plausibly material direct, infrastructure or indirect AI dependency
E_two_year_stress: overcapacity and price decline among AI suppliers
value migration from hardware to applications
rotation from technology to other growth areas

aiRemoval.joinKey: effective-dated entity_id plus listing_id at evaluation_at; current ticker joins are prohibited
aiRemoval.availabilityRule: classification evidence must pass the source-class availability contract and known_at <= evaluation_at
aiRemoval.materialityRule: Material requires sourced revenue, backlog or capex exposure, or a documented necessary product function. Narrative mention is not material.
aiRemoval.unclassifiedPolicy: any UNKNOWN blocks a single primary result. At coverage of at least 95 percent, report two complete sensitivity universes: UNKNOWN retained as non-AI and UNKNOWN removed with AI; both must account for every entity. Below 95 percent even sensitivity inference is NOT_READY.
aiRemoval.robustnessThreshold: Non-AI precision divided by total-universe precision is at least 0.80, while recall, signal count, base rate and 95 percent interval are reported, and no single replacement theme supplies more than 50 percent of remaining true positives.

historicalTimeCapsules.epistemicStatus: Pseudo-prospective historical reconstruction, never fully blind. Claims are limited to the earliest evidence found in the frozen corpus, not the earliest evidence that existed in the world.
historicalTimeCapsules.samplingRule: Cases are drawn from a frozen theme-era population including winners, failures and matched controls; companies cannot be selected individually after outcomes are viewed.
requiredQuestions: rule that separates successes without hindsight

futureThemeUniverse: advanced packaging, HBM, chiplets and silicon photonics
grids, HVDC, power semiconductors and cooling
nuclear energy, fuel cycle and geothermal
long-duration storage and flexible electricity demand
post-quantum cryptography, quantum sensing and quantum computing

themeEvidenceLevels.B: high entry probability with unresolved winners
themeEvidenceLevels.E: falsified or currently not suitable for evidence-based beneficiary mapping

dataContract.primaryFundamentals: SEC as-filed filings and accession metadata
dataContract.knownAt: max of every source-class-required timestamp, including SEC accepted_at, source_published_at, bar_available_at and observed_at where applicable; the result must be <= evaluation_at
requiredEntityFields: listing, acquisition, bankruptcy and delisting status
dataContract.prices: historically adjusted OHLCV with action provenance and delisting treatment
dataContract.survivorship: dead, acquired, bankrupt and delisted entities must remain in the historical universe
dataContract.researchSourceStore: append-only payload store with source-class-specific availability rule, content hash, immutable snapshot and frozen search corpus

splits.prospectiveObservationNoFinalScore: strictly after the final 1.1.0 freeze timestamp through 2026-12-31
splits.outcomeLock: After any 2021-2024 outcome is opened, no rule change may retain confirmatory status. Any change starts a new protocol and future test window.
splits.manualThemeConfirmation: Independent confirmation of manually coded theme evidence remains prospective from protocol freeze. Historical coding is pseudo-prospective validation only.

qualitativeCoding.blinding: Coders receive only sources available by the cutoff and cannot see later sources, price paths, GQS dates or outcome labels.

agreementGate.failureAction: Revise rules in development window only; do not open locked outcomes.

qualitativeCoding.equalResearchBudget: Same source classes, query protocol and time budget for winners, failures and matched controls.
qualitativeCoding.llmRestriction: LLM-generated labels are never treated as blinded independent coding because the model may contain later knowledge.

primarySuccessCriteria.leadDefinition: at least two eligible 10-Q/10-K publication events after the matrix signal and before first GQS confirmation; also report calendar and trading-session distance

prePriceBreakoutImprovement.endpoint: among signals that become true durable-growth positives within eight subsequent filing events, signalKnownAt precedes the next eligible market open after the primary 252-session breakout close; if no breakout occurs before outcome visibility, the signal counts as pre-breakout; listings without 315 completed sessions are right-censored and excluded with counts reported
prePriceBreakoutImprovement.comparison: full FEM minus its five matched non-signalled controls assigned the same evaluation timestamp
prePriceBreakoutImprovement.confidenceRule: entity-cluster bootstrap 95 percent interval lower bound must exceed 0

concentrationLimits.nonAiRobustness: after removal of all materially AI-dependent entities, precision must retain at least 80 percent of total-universe precision and at least 50 mature events must remain

technicalIncrementality.primaryComparison: two binomial logistic models with main effects only: T+E+L versus T+E+L+M on future durable growth within eight filing events; coefficients are fitted once on 2009-2016, continuous inputs are not added, missing dimensions are rejected, and neither interactions nor penalty tuning are allowed
technicalIncrementality.confidenceRule: entity-cluster paired bootstrap 95 percent interval lower bound for log-loss reduction must exceed 0

failureRules.hLate: Among mature durable-growth events with complete entity history, 315 pre-event price sessions and follow-up through maturity: late=1 when the primary breakout becomes available before first GQS qualification, including a missing GQS through maturity after a breakout; late=0 when GQS qualifies first or no primary breakout occurs by outcome visibility. Events censored before maturity are excluded and counted. H-LATE is confirmed at a late share of at least 70 percent and remains independent of matrix performance.
failureRules.hFem: FEM satisfies every primary matrix success criterion. This hypothesis is independent of whether GQS is late.
failureRules.technicalGrowthDetectionRejectedIf: technical-only arm fails matched growth-outcome baselines or loses significance after multiple-testing control.
failureRules.automationRejectedIf: full matrix fails any primary success criterion in the locked out-of-sample window.
failureRules.fallback: Keep GQS unchanged and operate early detection as manual, evidence-graded theme research.

statistics.unit: one earliest mature durable-growth event per entity for primary analysis; 12-quarter-cooldown events are secondary
statistics.leadTime: published quarters and trading sessions using availability timestamps
statistics.primaryBaseline: eligible non-signalled entity-date observations from the same historical sector, calendar quarter, market-cap quintile, listing-age bin, liquidity tertile and market regime

matching.ratio: five controls per signal without replacement within each signal; a control may be reused for a different signal date
matching.unmatchedRule: signal excluded from matched comparison and counted; more than 20 percent unmatched blocks H-FEM

statistics.marketRegimes: using the point-in-time broad-market total-return series: bear when close is at least 20 percent below its trailing 252-session high, otherwise recovery when a bear observation occurred in the prior 126 sessions and close is at or above SMA200, otherwise bull when close is above SMA200, 126-session return is positive and drawdown is below 10 percent, otherwise neutral
statistics.uncertainty: entity-clustered confidence intervals and block-bootstrap sensitivity
statistics.missingness: reported as missing; no zero fill and no future-derived imputation

premortem: price leads every measurable public signal
value captured by private firms or customers
modern vocabulary back-projected into old sources
